decision_conditions: The garage/utility and toilet area shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the existing dwelling and shall not be used as an independent dwelling at any time.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted standards, does not impact on neighbouring amenity and is in character with the existing form of development in the locality in accordance with relevant adopted planning policies of the Enfield Local Plan.

That the development granted by this planning permission must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this notice.  Reason: to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

That the proposed building(s) shall be finished externally in materials to match the existing building to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.  Reason: to secure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:SITE LOCATION/BLOCK PLANPLAN 6CA 05PLAN 6CA 06Design and access statementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

That all glazing in the flank elevation of the development hereby approved shall be in obscured glass and shall be maintained as such to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.  Reason: to safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties.
